snippet.title: Grid Gladiators Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3521010/Grid_Gladiators/#game_area_purchase

Releasing October 31, 2025

Grid Gladiators is a pixel art roguelike deckbuilder battler on a 2D grid. Multiple biomes, randomly generated terrain, and a push-your luck system of battle modifiers keep battles feeling fresh. Characters, cards, stickers, relics, and more create many paths to victory. Join the community's fight to conquer the Grid!
